decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - No development shall take place until the applicant has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological investigation which has been submitted by the applicant and approved by the Council. The development shall only take place in accordance with the detailed scheme pursuant to this condition. The archaeological works shall be carried out by a suitably qualified investigating body acceptable to the Council. 

Reason: Important archaeological remains may exist on this site. Accordingly the Council wishes to secure the provision of archaeological investigation and the subsequent recording of the remains prior to development in accordance with the requirements of policies EN41 and EN42 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 2 - The building shall be faced in the following materials
    unless other material are agreed in writing by the Council:-
    Planar Glazing (clear); Plinth: Cornish Granite (Grey);
    Framing System, Kawneer 60 mm System; Apron cladding and
    floor slab ends: reconstructed Portland stone; roof plant
    enclosure: aluminium louvres (Goose wing grey) as shown on
    the approved drawings.

Condition : 3 - Unless specified otherwise on the approved drawings, all
    glazing shall be clear.

Condition : 4 - All roof plant shall be contained within the roof plant
    enclosure herein approved.

Condition : 5 - The cycle parking shown on drawing no. PA/02B shall be so
    provided and maintained permanently.

Condition : 6 - The service bay accessed off Onslow Street shown on drawing
    PA02B shall be so provided and maintained permanently.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the first occupation of the building hereby
    approved, drawings at 1:20 scale shall be submitted to and
    approved by the Council showing disabled access to finished
    floor level inside the building from the main entrance.

Condition : 8 - The development shall be constructed in strict accordance with the drawings hereby approved or drawings which are subsequently approved pursuant to conditions which are attached to this planning permission.

Condition : 9 - The existing granite balusters on Onslow Street shall be
    retained and resited outside the new building as shown on
    drawing PA/02B.

Condition : 10 - Important archaeological remains may exist on this site .
    Accordingly the Council wishes to secure the provision of
    archaeological investigation and the subsequent
    recording of the remains prior to development.

Condition : 11 - To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the
    character of the immediate area.

Condition : 12 - To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the
    character of the immediate area.

Condition : 13 - So the Council may be satisfied with the external appearance
    of the buildings and to preserve views to the East from
    Clerkenwell Road.

Condition : 14 - In the interests of the future occupiers of the property and
    to comply with policy TR22 of the emerging UDP.

Condition : 15 - To ensure the building can be adequately serviced by
    vehicles.

Condition : 16 - In the interests of wheelchair bound users and to comply
    with policy RE8 in the emerging UDP.

Condition : 17 - To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the
    character of the immediate area.

Condition : 18 - To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the
    character of the immediate area.

Condition : 19 - The correct street number or number and name must be
    displayed permanently on the premises in accordance with
    regulations made under Section 12 of the London Building
    (Amendments) Act 1939.

Condition : 20 - Your attention is drawn to the fact that there is a separate
    legal agreement with the Council which relates to the
    development for which this permission is granted.

Condition : 21 - This consent is without prejudice to, and shall not be
    construed as derogating from, any of the rights, powers and
    duties of the Council pursuant to any of its statutory
    functions or in any other capacity and, in particular, shall
    not restrict the Council from exercising any of its powers
    or duties under the Highways Act 1980 (as amended).

Condition : 22 - The Building Regulations may impose requirements for the
    provision of access and sanitary conveniences for people
    with a physical impairment which limits their ability to
    walk, and people who need to use a wheelchair. In this
    respect you are advised to  consult the Council's
    Building Control Services, Camden Town Hall, Argyle Street
    WC1H 8EQ. (Tel:0171 413 6941)

Condition : 23 - The details required pursuant to additional conditions 1 & 7
    should be submitted with the attached approval of details
    application form together with 5 sets of drawings and any
    other supporting information.
description:
Redevelopment of existing office buildings to provide a 7
storey building plus basement extension for office/ B1 use
with roof plant enclosure together with a servicing bay onto
Onslow Street and associated internal cycle parking,
as shown on drawing numbers: Applicant's letter of 22 April
1999, as existing photographs, PA/00; 022/1120/1 - 10;  PA/
02B; PA/03A; PA/04A; PA/07A; PA/08A; PA/09A; PA/10A; and
PA/11A.
